packages.label_en: The Ten Utterances, Pre-Torah World-Sustenance, and the Free Gift
packages.reason: These four nodes all express the same underlying spiritual reality: the dimension of existence that preceded the giving of the Torah, in which the world was sustained purely by God's free, unconditional grace (chesed chinam). The Ten Utterances of Creation are the vehicle through which this pre-Torah sustenance operated. The 'free gift' (matnat chinam) names the quality of that sustenance. The 'world-sustenance before the giving of the Torah' is the temporal/structural frame that encompasses it all. Eretz Yisrael's ten sanctities are identified as a bechina of those same Ten Utterances, meaning the land embodies the same primordial holiness. All four are expressions of the same cosmic domain — the stratum of reality beneath/before Torah-obligation, where divine grace alone holds everything in being.
